output.reason: The subject and change are clear: [ev-a714bf0cb614] and the upgrade guide [ev-bea0311eb482] say the IPWhiteList middleware was renamed to IPAllowList, and the guide adds that its configuration is otherwise unchanged. The open aspect is the consequence, and neither text says what happens to a v2 configuration that still uses IPWhiteList in v3: whether it is rejected, ignored, or still accepted as a deprecated alias. The schema check makes this harder rather than easier: the CRD validator found spec.ipWhiteList in the traefik.io Middleware schema of both releases [ev-0842f8f3bd9d][ev-4fd00a8d9fd6], and found no version that drops it while adding spec.ipAllowList. We still need upstream text that says whether the old name keeps working, is deprecated, or has been removed.
